title: Chat panel
statement: The system shall offer a chat panel where Claude asks multiple-choice questions and proposes changesets that the user applies.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: choices blocks render as buttons and send the answer
The changeset card shows operations, diffs and verdicts and Apply writes it
A follow-up is sent after Apply and the reply is shown
The chat log persists per project
